name: Charles E. Wilson II
title: Associate Justice, California Court of Appeal, Sixth Appellate District
district: Sixth Appellate District (Santa Clara, Santa Cruz, Monterey, and San Benito counties)
years_of_service: Santa Clara County Superior Court 2014–2021; Sixth District Court of Appeal since 2021 (the court's bio says August 2021; the Daily Journal says July 2021). (Court of Appeal bio; Daily Journal)
background: Wilson earned a B.A. in political science from UCLA, and a J.D. and an MBA from the University of San Francisco. (Court of Appeal bio)

He worked in private practice, including at Gordon & Rees, before becoming a deputy district attorney in Alameda County in 2007. He was appointed to the Santa Clara County Superior Court in 2014, where he was supervising judge of the Family Violence Division and of the Palo Alto courthouse. (Court of Appeal bio; Daily Journal)
Gov. Newsom appointed him to the Sixth District in 2021 to succeed Justice Eugene M. Premo. Voters retained him in 2022 with 77.3%. (Court of Appeal bio; Ballotpedia)
